preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of points n in each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= r_i <= 10**9 for r_i in r)
preconditions.description: Each layer number r_i must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= c_i <= r_i for c_i, r_i in zip(c, r))
preconditions.description: Each point number c_i must be between 1 and the corresponding layer number r_i.
All points (r_i, c_i) must be distinct.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum cost of the path passing through all points.
